reviews.text: Outstanding! Zodiac pools delivered! Every aspect from concept to completion was done professionally, The entire team and crews has gone above and beyond expectations. Understanding that not living in town had something to do with timing, (No permits etc.) we were swimming in 4 weeks from the day we signed a contract. Thank you to Colin, Bryan, Emily, Braden and all of the various crews involved.
reviews.author: Joseph Sedach

reviews.text: Zodiac Pools exceeded my expectations from start to finish. The pool design was even better than I imagined, and the entire process—from excavation to having water in the pool—took just about seven weeks, which was incredibly impressive. What really stood out was the communication. Emily kept me updated at every step, explaining what was happening and what was coming next so I always knew what to expect. She and the entire team were responsive, patient, and thorough in answering all of my questions. Best of all, we stayed right on budget. I couldn’t be happier with the experience or the end result!
reviews.author: pamela Doolin

reviews.text: Zodiac was very helpful in helping me decide what I wanted in a pool. Their workmanship was excellent! They are very patient with me learning how to operate everything. One thing they could improve on is communication. I highly recommend them!
reviews.author: Glenda McCord

reviews.text: We had our pool built by Zodiac, and the experience was fantastic from start to finish. The construction process was smooth, professional, and the end result is beautiful—we couldn’t be happier with how everything turned out. Emily was very helpful and answered all of our questions quickly! On top of that, their weekly cleaning service has been excellent. The team is reliable, thorough, and always willing to answer questions or offer helpful advice. It’s clear they truly care about their customers. Highly recommend zodiac for both pool installation and maintenance!
reviews.author: Amanda Nuanes

reviews.text: Zodiac built my pool 3 years ago and I absolutely love it! I have used the service department for weekly service. This service has been excellent! Service technicians are reliable, knowledgeable and friendly.  They are always willing to answer questions and explain things. Communication has been excellent! If an issue or question arises Braden is very prompt in responding with an answer. I appreciate their dedication to service!
reviews.author: mary hoffmans

reviews.text: Had a pool built in April of 2020 and couldn't be happier about the whole experience. After price checking 2 other pool builders in the area, Zodiac had the best price by about $5,000 for the same exact pool! Collin did a great jot designing and explaining the pool and construction process to me. Bryan did a great job communicating and overseeing the pool construction. And Braden still does a great job overseeing the cleaning a maintenance of my pool to this day. I would highly recommend Zodiac Pools & Outdoor Living to anyone!
reviews.author: c R

reviews.text: We have enjoyed 4 summers so far with our beautiful pool. Zodiac Pools was an awesome choice! We are so pleased. Great honest people that care about what they do. 😊
reviews.author: Melissa Becker

reviews.text:
Our experience with Zodiac Pools was exceptional. At our initial consultation Colin listened to our expectations and went over all of our options to make sure we would get the pool of our dreams.  Building started in January and was completed in May with Zodiac verifying with our HOA, the city and the county of all needed permits prior to breaking ground. The various crews were all punctual and professional and their wonderful project manager Emily kept us abreast of the next steps as the work progressed. When an unwarranted issue arose with one of our neighbors, at our request, Zodiac went out of their way to ensure the neighbor's unwarranted concerns were put to rest. Zodiac went above and beyond in order to help us keep the peace with our neighbor. The ongoing maintenance has been excellent and punctual with Bryan answering any questions we may have. We have the pool of our dreams and have had no issues with the foundation of our home nor any issues with yard drainage due to the pool's construction.  We highly recommend Zodiac Pools to anyone who is looking for professionalism, quality, affordability, and transparency.

Thank you, Zodiac.
reviews.author: Ingrid Vieira
